answer:
According to the **CIA World Factbook**, **three** coastal South‑American countries established a national space agency before the year 2000.  
| Country | Space agency name (Factbook) | Year established |
|---------|-----------------------------|------------------|
| Argentina | National Space Activities Commission (CONAE) | 1991 |
| Brazil | Brazilian Space Agency (Agência Espacial Brasileira, AEB) | 1995 |
| Venezuela | Venezuelan Space Agency (Agencia de Estudios Espaciales, Ase) | 1999 |

Thus, **three** coastal South‑American nations—Argentina, Brazil, and Venezuela—had their space agencies in place by 1999, as recorded in the CIA World Factbook.
